facts: Sill is a native macOS 14+ app that turns the empty space at the top of the screen into a drag-and-drop shelf.
Drop a file, image, text snippet, or link onto the shelf, switch apps or Spaces, then drag it back into Finder or any app.
Core features are free and require no account. Content stays on the local Mac.
Clipboard is read only after an explicit user action; there is no background clipboard monitoring.
Small files are copied into Sill's local storage; large files are referenced with macOS security-scoped bookmarks.
Sill works on Macs with or without a display notch.
Sill Pro is a one-time, non-consumable in-app purchase (no subscription).

Pro unlocks unlimited active items, organization and editing tools, recovery and sensitive-content protection, custom shortcuts and appearance, layered dynamic scenes, the island companion Pobb, and an external skin pack marketplace.
Sill is available on the Mac App Store and as a direct download from sill-app.com.
Sill supports English and Simplified Chinese, light and dark appearance, and respects Reduce Motion.

faq.aEn: No. Sill's core drag, stash, search, and retrieve features work with no account. An optional Sill account (Apple or Google) is only used for the Pro trial and entitlement sync.
faq.aZh: 不需要。核心的拖入、暂存、搜索、取回功能无需账号。可选的 Sill 账号（Apple 或 Google）只用于 Pro 试用和权益同步。

faq.aEn: No. Sill Pro is a one-time, non-consumable in-app purchase. Previous purchases can be restored.
faq.aZh: 不是。Sill Pro 是一次性非消耗型内购，可恢复既有购买。

faq.qEn: Does Sill monitor my clipboard in the background?
faq.aEn: No. Sill reads the clipboard only after you explicitly trigger a capture. Stashed content stays on your Mac.
faq.qZh: Sill 会在后台监控剪贴板吗？
faq.aZh: 不会。只有你主动触发抓取时才会读取剪贴板，暂存内容留在本机。

faq.qEn: Does Sill work on a Mac without a notch?
faq.aEn: Yes. On a Mac without a notch, the shelf stays centered at the top edge of the display.
faq.qZh: 没有刘海的 Mac 能用吗？
faq.aZh: 可以。无刘海 Mac 上，置物岛固定在屏幕顶部居中位置。

faq.qEn: What macOS version does Sill require?
faq.qZh: Sill 需要什么系统版本？
faq.aZh: 需要 macOS 14 或更高版本。
